Rebrand
AffiniPay to 8am

  • Executive messaging
  • Media narrative
  • National launch
  • Cross functional

Six brands. One name. One announcement.

Directed the move from AffiniPay to 8am, strategy through national announcement. LawPay, CPACharge, MyCase, CasePeer, DocketWise, and the platform behind them had to read as one company without spending the trust each had earned. Executive messaging, the media narrative, and every contributing team moved behind a single coordinated rollout.

Today the platform supports more than 270,000 professionals and processes over 27 billion dollars in payments each year.

Two years, 300 to 500 plus in the room.

Helped grow the flagship conference from roughly 300 attendees in Austin to more than 500 in year two at the Wynn in Las Vegas. Press strategy, embargoed briefings, and keynote positioning sat with PR, anchored by Olympic gold medalist Gabby Thomas in year one and Savannah Bananas founder Jesse Cole in year two, plus a July exclusive with LawSites ahead of year two.

Partnerships
April to June 2026

  • Sports
  • Culture
  • Announcement sequencing
  • Partner approvals

Three stages, sequenced like a campaign.

Tampa Bay Buccaneers. A multi year deal naming 8am the Official Professional Services Partner, with naming rights to the 8am Club at Raymond James Stadium, nearly 10,000 square feet of premium space.

Tribeca Festival. The company's first major cultural partnership, with 8am sponsoring two world premiere screenings during the festival's 25th anniversary.

Finnegan's Foursome. The June 7 world premiere in the Spotlight Narrative section lists 8am as a partner on the festival's own archive page, and the afterparty carried the story past the screening.

The order was the strategy. The Tribeca release cites the Buccaneers deal as proof of momentum, so each announcement made the next one easier to believe. Relationships with Matt Damon and Olympic gold medalist Gabby Thomas widened the reach past trade media.

Writing

The page behind the headline.

Releases built so a reporter can file without a follow up call, and so an executive recognizes their own voice.

Anatomy of a release, Tribeca Festival partnership

The lede

Official partner of the 2026 Tribeca Festival, marking the company's first major cultural partnership.

News and significance in one sentence. A reporter can stop reading here and still file accurately.

The executive quote

Whether it is a filmmaker bringing a story to life or a professional driving meaningful outcomes for their firm, they pour everything into their craft.

Carries the argument a third person paragraph cannot make. Filmmakers and lawyers share one kind of ambition.

The boilerplate

Payments processed moved from 25 billion to 27 billion between March and April. Professionals served moved from 260,000 to 270,000 by May.

Updated for every release. Stale numbers are the quickest way to lose an editor's trust.
